flagged.comment: Gross Floor Area (GFA) of 83,986 sf divided by site area of 94,192 sf yields Floor Area Ratio (FAR) of 0.89:1, which exceeds the MF-2 maximum of 0.5:1. No approved variance, development bonus, or density bonus authorization is documented on the site plan or supplementary documents. The applicant must either obtain an approved FAR variance from the appropriate authority, claim and document an eligible development bonus, or reduce the gross floor area to achieve an FAR of 0.5:1 or less.

Proposed floor area ratio is 0.891:1 (gross floor area 83,986 sf ÷ site area 94,192 sf), which exceeds the MF-2 zoning maximum of 0.5:1 per LDC § 25-2-492. No approved variance, density bonus, or other exemption is documented on the site plan or in supplementary applications. Either reduce the proposed gross floor area to achieve a compliant FAR of 0.5:1 or lower, or submit documentation of an approved variance from the Board of Adjustment.

Gross floor area of 83,986 sf on a 94,192 sf site yields a Floor Area Ratio of 0.89:1, exceeding the maximum FAR of 0.5:1 allowed for MF-2 zoning per LDC § 25-2-492. No variance, bonus, or exemption documentation is provided. Reduce building mass or obtain an approved FAR variance prior to site plan approval.
